reason.needs-confirmation: needs confirmation: ask for it with -Include
reason.state-unreadable: its current state could not be read
reason.unverified-needs-admin: checked when applied: reading its state needs administrator
reason.journal-error: the backup could not be saved, so it was not applied
reason.reinstalled: reinstalled from the Microsoft Store for the current user
reason.not-reprovisioned: it was only provisioned for new users and cannot be provisioned again from the Store
reason.installed-for-other-users: other users had it: each must reinstall it from the Store
reason.onedrive-known-folders: left alone: a folder such as Desktop, Documents or Pictures is in OneDrive; move it back to the local folder first
reason.onedrive-online-only-files: left alone: OneDrive holds files or folders that only live in the cloud and would no longer open from this PC
reason.onedrive-scan-incomplete: left alone: not every file of OneDrive could be checked, so it is not certain that none lives only in the cloud
reason.onedrive-other-accounts: left alone: it is installed for all users and another account of this PC has OneDrive folders or files at risk
reason.onedrive-session-user: left alone: the process does not run as the account signed in at this desktop, which owns OneDrive and its files
reason.session-user: left alone: the process does not run as the account signed in at this desktop, so the setting would land in another account; open PowerShell as administrator from that account
reason.reinstalled-onedrive: OneDrive reinstalled with winget; sign in to OneDrive again
